cards.title: Action Capability Manifest admission (#110)

cards.title: Runner Identity SPIFFE format (#121)
cards.acceptance: Workers mint spiffe://works-execution/ns/<tenant>/sa/<worker-id> at enrollment. Identity validated by services/api/auth.go. Add tests in tests/identity/.

cards.title: Zero-Secret worker enrollment (#114)
cards.acceptance: Replace static WORKS_API auth with OIDC token exchange (or dev-mode SPIFFE-signed enrollment token). Reject static API keys. Add tests in tests/auth/.

cards.title: Hermetic Execution default (#111)
cards.acceptance: Subprocess sandbox applies default-deny: network=deny, secrets=none, FS=isolated, permissions=minimal. Override requires explicit capability manifest entry. Add tests in tests/hermetic/.

cards.title: Workflow Provenance attestation (#122)
cards.acceptance: services/provenance/ produces SLSA-style provenance per work matching the workflow-provenance.schema.json. Exposed via GET /v1/works/{id}/provenance. Signed. Tests in tests/provenance/.

cards.title: Evidence Bundle endpoint (#113, #124)
cards.acceptance: services/evidence/ produces signed JSON bundle matching evidence-bundle.schema.json. Exposed via GET /v1/works/{id}/evidence. Tests in tests/evidence/.

cards.title: Self-Healing failure classifier (#117)
cards.acceptance: services/classifier/ classifies each failure into the 10 categories from failure-classification.schema.json. Per-class retry policy + autonomous remediation set enforced. Tests in tests/classifier/.

cards.title: OpenTelemetry observability (#54, #65, #66)
cards.acceptance: services/observability/ exports W3C trace context + Prometheus metrics at /metrics. 32 metrics from the pack mapped per observability.md. Tests in tests/observability/.

cards.title: Capability-aware scheduler (#116, #118)
cards.acceptance: internal/scheduler/ scores eligible workers on cache locality + cost + queue + trust; explainability record per assignment. Tests in tests/scheduler/.

cards.title: SBOM + CycloneDX emission (#59, #61)
cards.acceptance: ci/local-runner/sbom.sh emits SPDX 3.0 + CycloneDX 1.6 per release. Stored under artifacts/sbom/. Tests in tests/supply_chain/sbom_test.go.

cards.title: OPA policy bundle (#96, #97)

cards.title: CloudEvents audit stream (#77, #67)
cards.acceptance: Every Work state transition emits a CloudEvents v1.0 message. Listener at /v1/audit-events. DORA metrics derived (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR). Tests in tests/audit/.

cards.title: Slice 1+2 regression gate

cards.title: Standards conformance suite
cards.acceptance: internal/standards/standards_test.go covers positive + negative validation for all 5 schemas. 13 tests passing.

cards.title: Docker worker sandbox (OCI runtime, hermetic defaults, image pull)
cards.acceptance: internal/sandbox/docker.go: Run(ctx, image, command, opts) executes a node under an OCI container with default-deny network, --read-only root, --cap-drop=ALL, --no-new-privileges, --pids-limit=256, --memory limit. Tests in tests/sandbox/docker_test.go with build tag `docker`; skipped when no daemon.
cards.notes: shipped slice 5. 5/5 docker tests pass, e2e_docker PASS in 2.3s, vet clean, standards-validate green, kanban-validate green, 7 binaries built.

cards.title: BYOC worker pool (Runner.Runtime field + scheduler host vs docker hard filter)
cards.acceptance: Runner.Runtime field on the registry; scheduler rejects host-only runners for docker-only nodes and vice versa. workgraph.Node.Runtime field defaults to host. Tests in tests/scheduler/ and tests/runner/.
cards.notes: BYOC scope merged into k-impl-013: workers select host vs docker backend based on Node.Runtime.Image. Scheduler honors the choice at the ready item layer. No separate Runner.Runtime field needed; the docker CLI invocation in internal/sandbox/docker.go IS the BYOC path. Adapter for non-Docker OCI runtimes (containerd, runc) deferred to slice 6.

cards.title: Real OPA runtime (replace Go interpreter with open-policy-agent/opa v1.0.0)

cards.title: End-to-end Docker smoke test (alpine:3.20 work reaches SUCCEEDED)
cards.acceptance: e2e_docker_test.go (build tag docker): submits a 2-node work where one node has Runtime.Image=alpine:3.20; runs API + worker; asserts SUCCEEDED + image_pull evidence recorded. ~30s timeout.
cards.notes: shipped slice 5. 5/5 docker tests pass, e2e_docker PASS in 2.3s, vet clean, standards-validate green, kanban-validate green, 7 binaries built.

cards.title: works-pilot CLI (measures time-to-first-successful-work against local API)
cards.acceptance: cmd/works-pilot/main.go: `works-pilot run-demo [--api URL]` submits a 2-node work, polls the API, prints a timeline of state transitions, and emits the wall-clock time-to-first-successful-work. Compares against the pack's <5min target. Exits 0 on success, 1 on timeout.
cards.notes: shipped slice 5. 5/5 docker tests pass, e2e_docker PASS in 2.3s, vet clean, standards-validate green, kanban-validate green, 7 binaries built.

cards.title: Real repo source: work-scoped token + exact SHA checkout
cards.acceptance: Given a repo URL + SHA + a work-scoped token (installation token, not PAT), `services/source/git.go` clones the repo into an isolated workspace, checks out the exact SHA, and returns a Cleanup() that removes the workspace. Token never appears in process env outside the git invocation. Unit tests cover checkout, cleanup, and SHA verification.
cards.notes: M1 card 2/8. ~300 LOC. Uses installation token scoped to single repo, expiring in 1h. `git clone --branch <branch>` then `git checkout <sha>` into /tmp/ws-<workid>.

cards.title: GitHub webhook receiver (HMAC verify + idempotent delivery)
cards.acceptance: POST /v1/webhook/github with valid HMAC-SHA256 (X-Hub-Signature-256) creates exactly one Work per (delivery_id, event). Invalid signature returns 401 and creates zero Works. Duplicate X-GitHub-Delivery is a no-op. Unit tests cover all 3 paths. Live test against a real webhook delivery works.
cards.notes: M1 card 1/8 (RFC-0003). services/webhook/github.go. ~300 LOC. Endpoints: POST /v1/webhook/github. HMAC-SHA256 verify against shared secret. Idempotency by X-GitHub-Delivery → webhooks table.

cards.title: Real runner: Go stack detect, run go vet + go test ./... -count=1
cards.acceptance: services/runner/real.go detects Go (go.mod), runs go vet + go test ./... -count=1, captures stdout+stderr, propagates exit code. Integration: SUCCEEDED on known-good, FAILED on known-bad.

cards.title: GitHub Check Run publisher
cards.acceptance: services/publisher/check.go POSTs /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs with name=works-execution, head_sha, conclusion, details_url. Installation token. Idempotent on (head_sha, name).

cards.title: Chaos test: kill worker mid-build, replacement recovers
cards.acceptance: e2e/chaos_worker_loss_test.go: submit Work, kill worker via SIGKILL mid-exec, start replacement with same ID, assert (1) original attempt cancelled with reason, (2) new attempt starts+completes, (3) work reaches SUCCEEDED, (4) both attempts in audit log.

cards.title: Benchmark: Actions vs WORKS (cold/warm/recovery) with JSON report
cards.acceptance: cmd/works-bench + services/bench for {Actions, WORKS subprocess, WORKS Docker} × {cold, warm, recovery} runs same work, writes docs/benchmarks/m1-*.md with queue_time, exec_time, wall_time, cpu_time, cache_hit_ratio, est_cost_usd, comparison table.

cards.title: Pilot UX: works connect github + works pilot <repo>
cards.acceptance: `works connect github` prints webhook URL+secret+perms, validates with ping. `works pilot <repo>` submits Work, polls for terminal state, prints timeline, exits 0 on success.

cards.title: Evidence enrichment: repo URL, SHA, runtime fingerprint, artifact SHA256
cards.acceptance: services/evidence/bundle.go adds source.repository/ref/sha, environment.go_version/runtime/image_digest/uname, artifacts[].sha256, attempts[].lease_id. Schema extended + validated.
